notes.title: v 1.0.1 is being released!
notes.content:
Changelog:

- Settings page: you can set fullscreen or window mode, and you can choose between Standarnd and Alternative keymaps for keyboard play. 
[u]You can also play with an external controller (this is an EXPERIMENTAL feature: I've tested it with arcade stick and Xbox controller and it works, but I can't guarantee full compatibility with gamepads or other devices)[/u]

- Minor bug fixes



Enjoy it! ;)
